questionReduction.rule: A missing SKU or project designation must not become a separate mandatory question when the row already has a truthful functional specification.
questionReduction.effect: The 17 dependent rows remain visible, but the minimum input asks only for real quantities or applicability decisions. Exact designations can be added later from project documents.
